name: 37321 · Dayton, TN
findings: ZIP 37321 (Dayton) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37321 (Dayton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37321 (Dayton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
